text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a Paladin.
source_text: You see a Paladin.

text: Sorry, can't talk, Initiate.
source_text: Sorry, can't talk, Initiate.

text: Good day.
source_text: Good day.

text: Did you know you could survive for weeks without water in a suit# of powered armor?
source_text:
Did you know you could survive for weeks without water in a suit
# of powered armor?

text: Don't you just love a good fight?
source_text: Don't you just love a good fight?

text: I really like the new laser rifles, but the old laser pistols# are my favorite.
source_text:
I really like the new laser rifles, but the old laser pistols
# are my favorite.

text: The night perimeter patrols are very dangerous. I wouldn't wander# too far at night if I were you.
source_text:
The night perimeter patrols are very dangerous. I wouldn't wander
# too far at night if I were you.

text: Be careful, it's a deadly world out there.
source_text: Be careful, it's a deadly world out there.

text: I think my armor has a spot on it!
source_text: I think my armor has a spot on it!

text: The Brotherhood is great. I haven't had any experience# outside of it, but it couldn't possibly get better than this.
source_text:
The Brotherhood is great. I haven't had any experience
# outside of it, but it couldn't possibly get better than this.

text: Good day, Initiate.
source_text: Good day, Initiate.

text: If you need anything, you should talk to Vree.
source_text: If you need anything, you should talk to Vree.

text: Vree's right over there if you need to talk to someone.
source_text: Vree's right over there if you need to talk to someone.

text: I've got to find time between the patrols and training to keep up# with my studies. I think I'm getting a little rusty.
source_text:
I've got to find time between the patrols and training to keep up
# with my studies. I think I'm getting a little rusty.

text: You've got to keep your mind and body in top condition at all times,# Initiate.
source_text:
You've got to keep your mind and body in top condition at all times,
# Initiate.

text: Being a Paladin isn't just combat, my son.
source_text: Being a Paladin isn't just combat, my son.

text: Being a Paladin isn't just combat, my lady.
source_text: Being a Paladin isn't just combat, my lady.

text: 你看见了一名游侠。
source_text: 你看见了一名游侠。

text: 对不起，我是个新兵，不能与外人谈话。
source_text: 对不起，我是个新兵，不能与外人谈话。

text: 天气不错啊。
source_text: 天气不错啊。

text: 你知道吗，穿上了能量装甲的话，就是不喝水，活几个礼拜也是没问题的。
source_text: 你知道吗，穿上了能量装甲的话，就是不喝水，活几个礼拜也是没问题的。

text: 你觉不觉得酣畅淋漓的战斗是种享受？
source_text: 你觉不觉得酣畅淋漓的战斗是种享受？

text: 我确实喜欢这把新的镭射步枪，但是我的最爱还是原来的镭射手枪。
source_text: 我确实喜欢这把新的镭射步枪，但是我的最爱还是原来的镭射手枪。

text: 晚上时候巡逻区以外都是很危险的，因此我建议你最好老实呆着。
source_text: 晚上时候巡逻区以外都是很危险的，因此我建议你最好老实呆着。

text: 小心点，外边很危险。
source_text: 小心点，外边很危险。

text: 我的护甲好像脏了。
source_text: 我的护甲好像脏了。

text: 兄弟会真是太棒了，尽管我从没去过别的地方，也知道没有哪里比这更好。
source_text: 兄弟会真是太棒了，尽管我从没去过别的地方，也知道没有哪里比这更好。

text: 天气真好，小兄弟。
source_text: 天气真好，小兄弟。

text: 有什么需要就去找弗蕾。
source_text: 有什么需要就去找弗蕾。

text: 你要是想要聊天的话弗蕾就在那等着呢。
source_text: 你要是想要聊天的话弗蕾就在那等着呢。

text: 我得想办法在巡逻和训练之间挤出点时间来保持学习进度。我想我已经有点生疏了。
source_text: 我得想办法在巡逻和训练之间挤出点时间来保持学习进度。我想我已经有点生疏了。

text: 你要时刻保证自己处于最佳状态，新兵。
source_text: 你要时刻保证自己处于最佳状态，新兵。

text: 做个游侠可不只是打打杀杀，小伙子。
source_text: 做个游侠可不只是打打杀杀，小伙子。

text: 做个游侠可不只是打打杀杀，小姐。
source_text: 做个游侠可不只是打打杀杀，小姐。
